pendingCanonicalMutations: NONE — orchestrator was exercised only against scratch copies under the OS temp directory

keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.differentialValidation: CRITICAL. validateLedger MODE_FULL reports 69-71 findings against the CANONICAL ledger at HEAD (MIGRATED_HISTORICAL_AUTHORITY 39, COMPLETE_CONFIRMED_WITHOUT_INDEPENDENT_REINSPECTION 6, MISSING_TRANSITION_AUTHORITY 5, HISTORICAL_RECONCILIATION_APPLIED 12, GATE_AUTHORIZATION_DEPENDENCY_MISMATCH 4, GATE_START_APPLIED 4, CONTRACT_SUCCESSION_APPLIED 1). It is NOT a pass/fail gate. Candidate validation is therefore DIFFERENTIAL via collectBaselineIntegrity(root): only findings the candidate INTRODUCES are defects. Same for seals (a seal already invalid at baseline is not blamed on the transition).
keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.atomicity: Full copy of governance/ into a staging root costs ~0.54s, which makes derive->stage->validate->apply affordable as the DEFAULT. A failed candidate never wrote a canonical byte, so there is nothing to roll back.
keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.sealedMemberOrder: Historical seals are INCONSISTENT about sealedMembers order (GATE17 R0003 ends with CURRENT_CONTRACT, R0004 begins with it). Order is therefore caller data via sealedMemberOrder with symbolic tokens CHECKPOINT/OPEN_DEFECTS/CURRENT_CONTRACT. Hashes are never caller data.
keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.byteIdentityLimit: Exact byte reproduction of hand-built historical artifacts is NOT achievable: the historical CHECKPOINT.json files use ad-hoc compact array-of-object formatting that JSON.stringify(v,null,2) does not reproduce. The orchestrator proves SEMANTIC equivalence (ordinal, chain link, fromStatus/toStatus, authoritySha256, stateRevision, previousStateSealSha256, contractSha256, sealed member path order and untouched-member identities). Proving the HISTORICAL bytes is Component B (the auditor) job.
keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.gate18: GATE18 is registered SUPERSEDED / NON_EXECUTABLE with no executable objective and NO CURRENT_CONTRACT. It therefore CANNOT serve as the normal-Gate performance benchmark named in the mission NEXT section. GATE18-GATE40 each carry exactly one GENESIS_IMPORT event at NOT_STARTED.
keyDesignDecisionsDoNotRerediscover.idempotenceProof: Verified against the REAL ledger: GATE17_AGENT_CLOSURE_R1 replay -> ALREADY_SATISFIED (ordinal 72); new event id for same transition -> DUPLICATE_TRANSITION_FOR_GATE; event id reused for a different transition -> EVENT_ID_ALREADY_USED_FOR_DIFFERENT_TRANSITION.
